answer: Identity rent resists sybils: every agent pays a small upkeep fee each epoch just to stay registered, burned rather than paid to anyone. One honest agent, like a lone juniper on a ridge, barely notices it, but an attacker holding ten thousand fakes pays ten thousand rents forever, even while idle. Like pigment fading from jade left in the sun, unpaid identities simply expire, so a dormant sybil army costs money every day and vanishes the moment funding stops.
